Results.ReviewText: When it came time to buy a new bbq for my boat I had to choose an actual marine bbq or a webber q. So many times in the past I was disappointed with the uneven heat of marine bbqs, burners that rot out amd price tags that could get you into a full size grill. I'm go glad I decided to try a webber q. Even heat ,never blows out, great size for a family of 4, simple assembly, and a fair price. This little grill doesn't disappoint. I've told other boaters if weber made marine mounting  options they would conquer the industry. The only down side to choosing this grill for a marine purpose is literally the fact you'll need to fabricate a mount, don't let that deter you.

Results.ReviewText: I bought this for camping and it’s been perfect to fit in the car as well as not take up a ton of room on the picnic table, yet plenty of surface to cook enough food for 7 people at once! I had 8 burger patties and 5 jumbo hotdogs all grilling at the same time. Everything cooked evenly and tasted great. The only minor complaint I have is the knob is very easy to accidentally turn on the propane if you bump it while moving it and not realize. Twice I smelled gas after moving it and noticed the knob was turned on. I now just remove the propane tank when we aren’t using it.

Results.ReviewText: Love the ease of use on this grill.  Everything is pretty much self-explanatory.  Just keep in mind that the grill plate is on the bottom of the box.  I had failed to notice this and kept on thinking they were shipping out just the grill without the grill plate.  But it's in fact on the bottom of the box, almost to the extent that you can miss it...I noticed it as I was about to throw the box out, noticing that it was heavier than it was supposed to be.  But the grill itself is rated one of the best and performs to its high expectations.  Lights up super easy and grills like a charm.  Wouldn't go to another brand and will stick with Weber for life.

Results.ReviewText: Best feature:  Curved, cast aluminum lid & body makes cleaning much easier than stamped steel with its corners & creases.  The porcelain-coated, cast iron grates are also a plus--others use welded steel rod.  The grates are two-piece so they easily fit in the sink for cleaning.  The fold-out side tables are handy for holding fixin's, just don't fold them in while the grill is hot.  My unit heats up quickly to 550 degrees and cooking, so far, is very good with consistent temperature, although two burners would be nice.  I use a 20-pound cylinder, so no issues with attaching the small bottles.  Other grills in this price range use low-grade stainless which discolors...check with a magnet.  The burner control is easier to use than most and the sturdy structure remains solid in the elements.  My cheaper brinkman cover fits fine.  A half-size griddle is available, but it's expensive.  If this table-topper lives up to Weber's reputation for dependability, I look forward to many seasons of outdoor delights.
Results.Title: Best Design Out There

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. We are so sorry to hear about your grill not heating up. We are happy to help. If you are using your grill with the adapter hose to a larger 20 lb. refill/exchange LP tank, it sounds like your grill may be in a safety mode known as “bypass." What’s happening is that the regulator thinks there’s a gas leak, so it reduces the pressure. Follow these instructions to reset the bypass safety mode. This is also the way you would want to start your grill each and every time.
 
Open the lid
Make sure the control knob is in the off position
Turn your LP tank on all the way
Wait 60 seconds
Turn the burner to start/high (first position to the left)
Hit your igniter
Close the lid to preheat to 500-550°F
 
For troubleshooting purposes, I would suggest using your grill with a 14 or 16 oz. disposable LP cylinder as well. That will let you know right away if the issue is with the grill, or with the adapter hose/LP tank.

Our Support team is reaching out to follow up. Please look for our outreach soon. Thank you!
